tools/simulation/ui/specs/worker-sale-al.name: Restricted worker sale tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/worker-sale-al.description: Checks a restricted worker confirming a sale only sees what their assigned flocks allow.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/worker.spec.ts.name: Worker walkthrough tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/worker.spec.ts.description: Plays a farm worker: enters eggs by grade and is blocked from flocks they are not assigned to.

tools/simulation/ui/src/api.ts.name: Test server calls
tools/simulation/ui/src/api.ts.description: Small helper that signs in and reads or changes data directly through the server for tasks a browser is bad at, such as cleanup.

tools/simulation/ui/src/ax.ts.name: Accessibility tree reader
tools/simulation/ui/src/ax.ts.description: Reads the browser's own description of the screen as seen by assistive tools, so tests can check what screen readers would get.

tools/simulation/ui/src/browser.ts.name: Test browser picker
tools/simulation/ui/src/browser.ts.description: Decides which browser program the tests launch, honouring a forced choice, and reports which one is used.

tools/simulation/ui/src/cast.ts.name: Test cast of users
tools/simulation/ui/src/cast.ts.description: Loads the made-up farm staff (owner, manager, worker and others) that tests sign in as.

tools/simulation/ui/src/dashboard-fixtur.name: Dashboard test setup
tools/simulation/ui/src/dashboard-fixtur.description: Shared test setup for the dashboard checks.

tools/simulation/ui/src/dom.ts.name: Screen lookup helpers
tools/simulation/ui/src/dom.ts.description: Small helpers for picking dropdown options and searchable pickers by part of their visible text.

tools/simulation/ui/src/env.ts.name: Test environment settings
tools/simulation/ui/src/env.ts.description: Says where the test farm is running and how long tests should wait, including opt-in for slow checks.

tools/simulation/ui/src/expenses.ts.name: Open expenses helper
tools/simulation/ui/src/expenses.ts.description: Takes a test to the seeded expenses screen on desktop or phone.

tools/simulation/ui/src/farm.ts.name: Farm dates and counts
tools/simulation/ui/src/farm.ts.description: Works out the farm's own today and formats counts the way the app shows them, not by the test machine's settings.

tools/simulation/ui/src/fixtures.ts.name: Shared test toolkit
tools/simulation/ui/src/fixtures.ts.description: The common test setup every browser test uses: signing in (including the code step), and phone or desktop menu helpers.

tools/simulation/ui/src/i18n.ts.name: Screen text lookup
tools/simulation/ui/src/i18n.ts.description: Looks up on-screen wording from the app's own language files so tests do not retype it.

tools/simulation/ui/src/mutants.ts.name: Planned breakages list
tools/simulation/ui/src/mutants.ts.description: Lists the deliberate breakages the sabotage check applies to prove the browser tests can fail.

tools/simulation/ui/src/preflight.ts.name: Test pre-check
tools/simulation/ui/src/preflight.ts.description: Runs before the tests to confirm the test farm is up and reachable.

tools/simulation/ui/src/totp.test.mjs.name: Authenticator code tests
tools/simulation/ui/src/totp.test.mjs.description: Checks the code generator for two-step sign-in produces correct codes.

tools/simulation/ui/src/totp.ts.name: Authenticator codes
tools/simulation/ui/src/totp.ts.description: Generates the six-digit two-step sign-in codes for the test owner, waiting for the next 30-second window when needed.

tools/simulation/ui/src/vitals.ts.name: Page speed measuring
tools/simulation/ui/src/vitals.ts.description: Measures how fast and stable a screen loads, inside the page itself, and prints the results as a table.
